requirements.title: Random quote on bot mention
requirements.acceptance: Mentioning the bot without a recognised command still replies with one non-empty quote from bot/src/modules/ruckus_quotes.txt.

requirements.title: !help and !commands
requirements.acceptance: !help returns the full help text and !commands returns the shortened list, each exactly once per message.

requirements.title: !flipacoin heads|tails
requirements.acceptance: !flipacoin heads and !flipacoin tails reply once with the user choice and a Heads/Tails result; the random outcome remains uniform.

requirements.title: Weather by mention and !weather
requirements.acceptance: Both documented weather forms return current conditions for a valid city and a clear message for an invalid one.

requirements.title: Free game giveaways
requirements.acceptance: !freegames and the mention form return current PC game giveaways from gamerpower.com.

requirements.title: Joke command
requirements.acceptance: !joke and the documented mention phrasing return one joke from the joke API.

requirements.title: N-chain word gag
requirements.acceptance: Standalone n, i, g, e, r messages continue the chain and a second g is produced after the first g, without changing other replies.

requirements.title: Profanity insult reply
requirements.acceptance: A message containing a listed profanity term receives one insult reply; ordinary messages never receive one.

requirements.title: Owner easter egg
requirements.acceptance: The configured owner ID saying "hello my child" receives "Hello Father." and no other user does.

requirements.title: Dashboard status view
requirements.acceptance: The dashboard shows bot name, online/offline state and the connected guild list for the current bot session.

requirements.title: Dashboard restart action
requirements.acceptance: An authorised operator can restart the bot process from the dashboard and sees a definite success or failure result.

requirements.title: Login and first account creation
requirements.acceptance: A first-run admin account can be created, the owner can log in, and later accounts obey role rules.

requirements.title: Log REST API
requirements.acceptance: Existing log list/read/create/update/delete, login and interaction filters and both count endpoints keep working for authorised callers.

requirements.title: Container and compose deployment shape
requirements.acceptance: A single image serving bot, API and dashboard on port 8080 still builds and runs, and the compose file still brings up bot, database and phpMyAdmin.

requirements.title: Honour MYSQL_PORT in every database pool
requirements.spec_section: Honour MYSQL_PORT in every database pool
requirements.acceptance: With MYSQL_PORT=13306 and no service on 3306, API, dashboard and bot all connect successfully.

requirements.title: Serve live bot status instead of a build-time snapshot
requirements.spec_section: Serve live bot status instead of a build-time snapshot
requirements.acceptance: After a new bot_login row is inserted, /api/bot-status reflects it without rebuilding the dashboard.

requirements.title: Correct the check-admin upstream path
requirements.acceptance: GET /api/check-admin returns 200 with {adminExists:boolean} against a running API.

requirements.title: Remove forced-admin account creation and permanent lockout
requirements.spec_section: Remove forced-admin account creation and permanent lockout
requirements.acceptance: A first admin can be created; afterwards an admin can create a user or operator, and role comes from the request, never a constant.

requirements.title: Require authentication and authorisation on every API route
requirements.spec_section: Require authentication and authorisation on every API route
requirements.acceptance: Every route returns 401 without a session and 403 for insufficient role; verified by an automated route matrix test.

requirements.title: Never return password hashes
requirements.acceptance: Authentication and user responses contain no password or hash field in any response body or log.

requirements.title: Idempotent schema creation for a fresh install
requirements.spec_section: Idempotent schema creation for a fresh install
requirements.acceptance: Starting the stack against an empty MySQL 8.4 server creates database, tables and indexes with no manual SQL.

requirements.title: Repair the logEvent callback contract
requirements.acceptance: logEvent(type, data, callback) invokes the callback exactly once with null or an Error, and the ready retry loop terminates.

requirements.title: Replace the unsupported MySQL driver in the bot
requirements.spec_section: Replace the unsupported MySQL driver in the bot
requirements.acceptance: The bot logs to MySQL 8.4 using mysql2 and an automated check proves a row is written.

requirements.title: Register the ready handler exactly once
requirements.spec_section: Register the ready handler exactly once
requirements.acceptance: Startup logs no "client.user is null" error and exactly one bot_login row is written per login.

requirements.title: Fix the uninterpolated startup log line
requirements.spec_section: Fix the uninterpolated startup log line
requirements.acceptance: The no-guilds startup line prints the real bot id and name.

requirements.title: Return a handled result from the coin flip handler
requirements.spec_section: Return a handled result from the coin flip handler
requirements.acceptance: A !flipacoin message produces exactly one bot reply even when it mentions the bot.

requirements.title: Stop the N-chain empty message and global state
requirements.spec_section: Stop the N-chain empty message and global state
requirements.acceptance: Typing e before g sends no empty message, produces no API error and does not permanently change later chains.

requirements.title: Require the documented trigger for jokes
requirements.spec_section: Require the documented trigger for jokes
requirements.acceptance: A message containing "tell me a joke" without a bot mention receives no joke; both documented forms do.

requirements.title: Fix weather parsing, encoding and error replies
requirements.spec_section: Fix weather parsing, encoding and error replies
requirements.acceptance: !weather in Paris and the mention form return real conditions; unknown city returns one readable message with no "undefined".

requirements.title: Bound the free-games response
requirements.acceptance: One invocation sends at most one message, respects the 6000-character embed budget and never exceeds Discord limits.

requirements.title: Cache the profanity list and fail safe
requirements.spec_section: Cache the profanity list and fail safe
requirements.acceptance: Ordinary messages cause no outbound HTTP request and an unavailable list never triggers a reply.

requirements.title: Correct log pagination ordering and validation
requirements.spec_section: Correct log pagination ordering and validation
requirements.acceptance: Newest rows come first, limit/offset are clamped to 1..100 and >=0, invalid values return 400 and totals are exposed on every list route.

requirements.title: Fix CORS exposure order and restrict origins
requirements.spec_section: Fix CORS exposure order and restrict origins
requirements.acceptance: X-Total-Count is readable by the browser and only configured origins are allowed.

requirements.title: Remove duplicate and dead API code
requirements.spec_section: Remove duplicate and dead API code
requirements.acceptance: One definition per exported function, no unused dependency, and lint reports no unused symbols.

requirements.title: Make restart reliable and observable
requirements.acceptance: Restart returns 202 with a job id, reports success within 20 s when the process returns, and reports a clear failure otherwise.

requirements.title: Bound the processed-message cache
requirements.acceptance: The dedupe cache evicts after 10 minutes and never exceeds 5000 entries under a 50k-message synthetic run.

requirements.title: Await or handle every Discord send
requirements.spec_section: Await or handle every Discord send
requirements.acceptance: A rejected send is logged once with context and produces no unhandledRejection; verified by a fault-injection test.

requirements.title: Fail fast and shut down cleanly
requirements.spec_section: Fail fast and shut down cleanly
requirements.acceptance: Invalid token exits with code 1 and one actionable line; SIGTERM closes the gateway and the pool within 10 s.

requirements.title: Repair help text and stop double replies
requirements.spec_section: Repair help text and stop double replies
requirements.acceptance: Help lists exactly the shipped commands with correct newlines and dynamic bot id; help/commands never also trigger a quote.

requirements.title: Validate all API input
requirements.acceptance: Missing, empty, over-length or malformed username/password/role/query input returns 400 with a field-specific message.

requirements.title: Replace the non-idempotent schema seed
requirements.acceptance: Applying migrations twice is a no-op; no plaintext password row is inserted.

requirements.title: Make setup documentation executable
requirements.acceptance: The documented compose example validates with docker compose config and the documented steps bring up a working stack.

requirements.title: Stop committing node_modules and use a supported runtime
requirements.spec_section: Stop committing node_modules and use a supported runtime
requirements.acceptance: git ls-files **/node_modules is empty, .dockerignore exists and the image runs Node 26 LTS (or the recorded fallback).

requirements.title: Remove or adopt stray root files
requirements.spec_section: Remove or adopt stray root files
requirements.acceptance: pagination.js, page.js.old and the root package.json are either deleted with a recorded decision or wired into a tested feature.

requirements.title: Replace localStorage authentication
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard pages are protected by a server-validated session cookie; deleting localStorage grants no access.

requirements.title: Implement the user management screen
requirements.acceptance: The header entry opens a working user list with create, role change, disable and delete for admins.

requirements.title: Add a real test and lint baseline
requirements.spec_section: Add a real test and lint baseline
requirements.acceptance: npm test runs unit + HTTP contract tests, npm run lint passes, and npm run verify reproduces both locally.

requirements.title: Remediate vulnerable dependencies
requirements.acceptance: npm audit --omit=dev reports no critical or high advisory in any of the three packages at the release commit.

requirements.title: Bound log growth and write pressure
requirements.spec_section: Bound log growth and write pressure
requirements.acceptance: A retention job prunes rows older than the configured window and inserts use a bounded queue that drops with a counted warning.

requirements.title: Self-host images and fix empty document title
requirements.spec_section: Self-host images and fix empty document title
requirements.acceptance: No dashboard view loads an image from a third-party host, and the title is meaningful online and offline.

requirements.title: Expose health and readiness endpoints
requirements.acceptance: GET /health returns process status and GET /ready returns database reachability with correct 200/503 codes.

requirements.title: Document privileged intents and drop unused ones
requirements.spec_section: Document privileged intents and drop unused ones
requirements.acceptance: README states which privileged intents are required and why, and the client requests only intents in use.

requirements.title: Return consistent API errors with correlation ids
requirements.spec_section: Return consistent API errors with correlation ids
requirements.acceptance: Errors return {error:{code,message,requestId}} and the same requestId appears in the server log.

requirements.title: Make the dashboard build hermetic
requirements.acceptance: next build succeeds with the API stopped and makes no outbound request during build.

requirements.title: Session-based authentication with role-based access control
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Session-based authentication with role-based access control
requirements.acceptance: Roles admin/operator/viewer are enforced server-side; an access matrix test covers every route and role.

requirements.title: Password policy, hashing cost and login abuse controls
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Password policy, hashing cost and login abuse controls
requirements.acceptance: Minimum 12 characters, bcrypt cost >= 12, per-IP and per-account login throttling, and lockout after 10 failures in 15 minutes.

requirements.title: CSRF, cookie and transport protections
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Session cookies are HttpOnly, Secure when served over HTTPS, SameSite=Lax; mutating requests require a CSRF token.

requirements.title: Validated configuration and secret handling
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Startup fails with a named missing variable; no secret is committed, logged or exposed to the browser.

requirements.title: Input validation and safe rendering
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: All external input is validated server-side and rendered without raw HTML injection in the dashboard.

requirements.title: Dependency update and audit policy
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Lockfiles are committed, installs use npm ci, and a documented monthly audit gate blocks critical/high advisories.

requirements.title: Least-privilege database account and schema ownership
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Least-privilege database account and schema ownership
requirements.acceptance: The application user has only DML on its schema; migrations run with a separate documented account.

requirements.title: Message-content privacy and retention
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Message content logging is off by default or explicitly documented, with a configurable retention window and export/delete path.

requirements.title: Abuse and rate limits for bot and API
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Abuse and rate limits for bot and API
requirements.acceptance: Per-user command cooldowns and API rate limits are enforced and observable; exceeding them produces a clear message, not silence.

requirements.title: Supply-chain and image hygiene
requirements.authority: Owner goal: security hardening; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Base images are pinned by digest, the image runs non-root, and the built image is scanned with a recorded result.

requirements.title: Live bot status with heartbeat and uptime
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.spec_section: Live bot status with heartbeat and uptime
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard shows online state, uptime, gateway latency, guild count and last heartbeat age, refreshed at least every 30 s.

requirements.title: Log explorer with filters, paging and export
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.spec_section: Log explorer with filters, paging and export
requirements.acceptance: An operator can filter by event type, user, guild and date range, page deterministically and export the current filter to CSV.

requirements.title: User management with roles
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Admins can list, create, change role, disable and delete accounts; operators see read-only data; viewers see status only.

requirements.title: Slash commands alongside message commands
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Registered guild and global slash commands cover flip, weather, joke, freegames and help, and message commands still work.

requirements.title: Per-guild settings
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: An admin can set prefix, enable/disable features, restrict channels and owners per guild, persisted and applied at runtime.

requirements.title: Command cooldowns and quiet channels
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Repeated invocation inside the cooldown receives one ephemeral or reply warning, and quiet channels suppress non-command replies.

requirements.title: Cached integrations with last-known-good fallback
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Giveaway and profanity data are cached with a TTL, served from cache on upstream failure and never fetched per message.

requirements.title: Weather upgrade: geocoding, units, forecast
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: City lookup is encoded and validated, metric/imperial is selectable and a short forecast is available.

requirements.title: Free-games digest with filters
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: One compact digest lists up to 10 giveaways with store filter and a stable ordering, with a link to the full list.

requirements.title: Quote management
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Quotes can be listed and added by an authorised user, persisted in the database with the file as seed.

requirements.title: Dashboard analytics
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard charts show interactions per day, top commands and error counts for a selected range.

requirements.title: Offline and error alerting
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: A configurable webhook receives one alert when the bot is offline beyond the threshold and one recovery notice.

requirements.title: Backup and restore tooling
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Documented scripts create a timestamped dump, verify it, and restore into an empty database in a drill.

requirements.title: Metrics endpoint
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: GET /metrics returns Prometheus text with command, error, latency and queue counters.

requirements.title: Responsive, accessible theme with self-hosted assets
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.spec_section: Responsive, accessible theme with self-hosted assets
requirements.acceptance: Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px, keyboard focus is visible, contrast meets WCAG 2.2 AA for text, and assets are local.

requirements.title: Configuration validation and .env.example
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: A committed .env.example lists every variable with purpose and safe default, and startup validates types and ranges.

requirements.title: Local development ergonomics
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: A single documented command starts database, API, dashboard and bot in dev mode with seeded demo data and a smoke check.

requirements.title: Per-guild health self-report
requirements.authority: Owner brief: suggest and add genuine new features without removing existing ones
requirements.acceptance: Dashboard lists each guild with member count, channel count and last activity time from the bot cache.

requirements.title: Reproducible non-root image on a supported runtime
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Reproducible non-root image on a supported runtime
requirements.acceptance: docker build from a clean clone succeeds with npm ci, runs as a non-root user and reports a pinned base digest.

requirements.title: Compose stack with healthchecks and supported database
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Compose stack with healthchecks and supported database
requirements.acceptance: Compose starts MySQL 8.4, API, dashboard and bot with healthchecks, correct env names and no published database port by default.

requirements.title: Startup, readiness, liveness and graceful shutdown
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.spec_section: Startup, readiness, liveness and graceful shutdown
requirements.acceptance: Container health reflects readiness; SIGTERM drains in-flight work and exits 0 within 15 s.

requirements.title: Structured logging with retention
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: API and bot emit JSON logs with level, request/job id and no secrets; container log retention is documented.

requirements.title: Backups and restore drill
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: A restore drill restores a dump into an empty database and the dashboard reads the restored data.

requirements.title: Monitoring and alert runbook
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: A runbook defines what to check, thresholds and first actions for bot offline, API 5xx, DB down and disk pressure.

requirements.title: Release, rollback and evidence procedure
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Each release records image digest, migration state, smoke results and a tested rollback to the previous digest.

requirements.title: Database migration procedure
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Numbered forward-only migrations run before app start, are idempotent, and a failed migration aborts startup with the failing file named.

requirements.title: Capacity targets and measurement plan
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: Targets for 50 guilds and 20 msg/min are recorded, with a repeatable load check and measured baseline before scaling claims.

requirements.title: Incident ownership and support path
requirements.authority: Owner goal: improvements; baseline review evidence
requirements.acceptance: One named operator role, a contact path and a post-incident record template exist in the operating kit.

requirements.title: Accurate setup, configuration and troubleshooting documentation
requirements.spec_section: Accurate setup, configuration and troubleshooting documentation
requirements.acceptance: A new maintainer can go from clone to running stack using only readme.md and docs/, with no dead commands or invalid YAML.

requirements.title: Local guides for each real area and updated AGENTS.md
requirements.spec_section: Local guides for each real area and updated AGENTS.md
requirements.acceptance: bot/, api/ and dashboard/ each have a local README/AGENTS guide matching the shipped behaviour.

requirements.title: Memory and handoff discipline
requirements.acceptance: Durable decisions are in data/decisions.json and MEMORY.md; the handoff names current task, authority and next action.

requirements.title: Versioning and change log
requirements.acceptance: A CHANGELOG records each released version with the requirement IDs it closes.
